name: ihris
description: The procedures used to build the iHRIS knowledge base: describing Launchpad and GitHub sources by reference, extracting I2CE modules and the data model from a verified release, ingesting the Implementation Toolkit, and restoring wiki pages. Also: adopting a methodology from a shared source, wireframe design review (WireGen), and iHRIS 4 on FHIR (documented; sushi later). Also: building the iHRIS-themed harness site.
